name: ais
description: Memory for agents and people: exact recall from a plain-text index, by your own keys.
long_description: An agent recalls what you filed by the keys you filed it under, instead of searching for it again. Read-only unless you allow saving; there is no delete or edit at any setting. Encrypted values reach the agent as an opaque marker.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Records filed under all (or any) of the given keys

tools.name: find
tools.description: Records whose value contains a text

tools.name: tags
tools.description: The keys in use, busiest first

tools.name: save
tools.description: File a value under keys; offered only when saving is allowed

index.title: Index
index.description: A project's index to serve instead of your home index: the .ais folder, or the folder holding it. Leave empty for your current index (~/.ais unless you switched); a .ais above the client's working folder then makes the server refuse to start.

writes.title: Allow saving
writes.description: Offer the save tool. Nothing can delete or edit at any setting.
